records.context: The owner thinks her customers want sweeter food. The cook questions that, asks how, and gives in as she leaves it to him. The impersonal notice forecasts a possible trend.
records.source_meaning: The notice forecasts a trend for sweets in Alexandria. Keep the link to the discussion and the established market wording.
records.localization_note: Keep the forecast tentative and use the same town and trend wording as the other copies.

lines: Sweets may catch on in Alexandria.
